Check_Title: Ensure SSH Root Login Is Disabled
Description: Prevents direct root authentication over SSH; reduces the impact of a single compromised credential.

Check_Title: Ensure SSH Password Authentication Is Disabled
Description: Requires key-based authentication for SSH instead of passwords.

Check_Title: Ensure UFW Is Installed and Running
Description: Host-based firewall enforcing network boundary protection.

Check_Title: Ensure Default Deny Firewall Policy Is Set
Description: Default-deny inbound policy limits exposure to only explicitly allowed services.
Restricts write access to the system account database.
Restricts read access to password hashes.

Check_Title: Ensure No Duplicate UID 0 Accounts Exist
Description: Prevents undocumented accounts with root-equivalent privileges.
Kernel-level memory protection that reduces exploit reliability.

Check_Title: Ensure Auditd Is Installed and Enabled
Description: Provides tamper-resistant logging of security-relevant system events.

Check_Title: Ensure Automatic Security Updates Are Configured
Description: Reduces the exposure window for known vulnerabilities through timely patching.
Removes a cleartext remote-access service with no legitimate use case in this environment.
